name: suade
description: Suade — the narrative compiler and deck critic for Claude Code and Cowork

plugins.name: suade
plugins.description: Critique any deck's narrative against a specific audience (YC, board, a16z...), and compile a blueprint — evidence, strategy, spine — from your source materials. Files-first: the blueprint lives in your folder, diffable and recompilable. Does not paint slides; hands off to Gamma, Google Slides, or Claude Design.
